Hard call (uncertain): market risk disclosure applied to this report, but it is printed only as 'QUANTITATIVE AND QUALITATIVE DISCLOSURES ABOUT MARKET RISK' (line 1474), an unnumbered subheading at the end of MD&A in the same all-caps style as MD&A's other subheadings, and the contents list does not name Item 7A. Item 7A is listed absent and the text stays in Item 7; the alternative labels Item 7A at line 1474, as the A10 Networks label did for an unnumbered Item 1 heading. Hard call (uncertain): Schedule II is printed after Item 14's exhibit list and its part (B) on Form 8-K reports, with no Item heading, then SIGNATURES. Item 14 only lists the schedule by page, so it ends at 'SCHEDULE II' (line 2337), following the fresh3 Vesta 2003 label; the alternative keeps the schedule in Item 14 to SIGNATURES. Item 10 holds the executive officers list and is not marked; Items 9 and 11 to 13 are marked incorporated. Items 3 and 4 give answers ('There are no pending legal proceedings', 'No matters were submitted') and are not marked. The filing ends at SIGNATURES (line 2364).
